name: hud_ui_menu_back_button_on_activate
description: HudUiMenuBackButton::OnActivate queues exit from the current app state, performs the normal ZRD widget activation behavior, and triggers current-layout activation.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers 0x414fa0.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414fa0 validates calling RecoilApp::QueueExitCurrentState with parameter 0, restoring self, calling HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate, then calling HudUiMgr::TriggerCurrentLayoutOnActivated.

Native smoke hud_ui_menu_back_button_on_activate_smoke constructs a frontend main-menu dialog, dispatches the Back button activation slot, verifies a queued ExitCurrent item with parameter 0, verifies one current-state OnExit dispatch and no OnEnter dispatch, verifies the base activation image update, and verifies one current-layout OnActivated callback.
